verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Aircall supports an OAuth flow for apps and Basic Authentication for its Public API. Nothing documents scopes, permission restrictions, or least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. OAuth and Basic Auth alone are authentication mechanisms, not evidence of scoped credentials, so they earn only adjacent, no-credit support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
